preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10,000.
The length of the string S is between 1 and 1,000,000.

preconditions.expression: Sum of len(S) over all test cases <= 10^6
preconditions.description: The sum of the lengths of all strings S across all test cases does not exceed 1,000,000.

preconditions.expression: S consists of lowercase English alphabets only
preconditions.description: Each character in S is a lowercase English alphabet letter.

postconditions.description: The output is either -1 if no valid string P exists, or an integer representing the maximum length of a valid string P.
